query: I was out at the community farmers market this morning and picked up the most delicious ripe peaches, they’re so juicy I had to wipe my hand on my jeans twice just now after eating one. On the way home, I stopped at the new dog park to let my golden retriever puppy run around, and he made friends with a tiny corgi that kept stealing his tennis ball. When I got back to my car I realized I forgot to grab a jar of the local honey I wanted, I’ll have to go back next weekend to pick some up. Anyway, I’m having some issues with my phone right now: the storage permission for my apps seems to be broken, and I also got an alert that my mobile data usage has exceeded my plan limit, can you help me fix these issues?
